answer: Post the hash of each work receipt first, reveal it 1 epoch later, and let 5 jurors score it blind. Any 2 dissenting scores cut the payout 20%. A cloned identity cannot audit its own recruit, so a meadow of 200 aliases needs 1,000 outside jury slots per epoch. Where peers disagree the score dilutes toward 1, so padding a reef of weak receipts lowers the average instead of raising it. A beacon of new addresses costs 1,000 jury slots and 200 locked bonds before anything pays.
